bankrupt.detail: Bankruptcies: {{times}} · Starting capital is restored {{date}} at 09:00

toast.resetDone: Account reset to its initial state

reset.title: Reset account
reset.desc: Clears all positions, orders, game records and asset history, and restores your balance to the starting capital. Comments, mute status and campaign points already earned are not affected. During the campaign the first reset each week is free, every reset after that costs 30 campaign points; once the campaign ends you get 1 reset per week (refreshed on Monday).
reset.warnClears: This cannot be undone. It clears: all spot and futures positions and orders, prediction bets, Blackjack / Mines / Video Poker records, asset history, daily buffs and wallet transfer records.
reset.warnCost: During the campaign the first reset each week is free, every reset after that costs 30 campaign points (automatic bankruptcy recovery counts as well). Campaign points already earned, check-ins and votes are not affected by a reset.

history.title: Futures position history
history.desc: Each row is one complete position, from open to fully closed. Expand a row to see every fill in that position: quantity, price, and whether it was closed manually or triggered by a stop loss / take profit. Realized PnL is net (fees and funding already deducted); the return is measured against the total margin invested.
history.note: Only fully closed positions are listed. A partially closed position is still open and its final PnL is not settled yet — the part already booked shows as “Realized PnL” on that position's card on the portfolio page.
history.noFills: This position has no fills — it is an old position closed directly when the account was wiped after a blowup

trades.title: All trades
trades.desc: Everyone's spot and futures fills, mixed and sorted newest first. Trade details are shown as they are; each trader gets one fixed alias — the same alias is the same person, but you cannot tell who.

force.title: Liquidations
force.desc: Recent liquidations on the Binance futures market. SELL means longs were liquidated, BUY means shorts were liquidated. Large back-to-back liquidations usually mean short-term volatility and amplified sentiment, but they are not a standalone trading signal.
force.descShort: Binance futures liquidations. SELL = longs liquidated, BUY = shorts liquidated.
force.statAmountHint_one: Counts the {{count}} record on this page only
force.statAmountHint_other: Counts the {{count}} records on this page only
force.listDesc: Sorted by fill time, newest first. {{size}} per page, {{total}} records in total.
force.warn: A large liquidation does not mean an immediate reversal — it only means that side was just forced out.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.desc: The raw record of every balance change on your account, newest first. One action creates one row per wallet it touches, so opening a futures position shows both a margin row and a fee row.
ledger.loadFailed: Failed to load the ledger, tap refresh at the top right to retry

chart.gameWalletNote: Cannot be traded directly, transfer to the balance wallet first
chart.noHistory: No history yet — a snapshot is taken every day at midnight
